feedback.objective: mean absolute masked log-spectral MAE for 512/2048/8192 + 0.35 * 20-ms RMS log-MAE; fixed calibration

psychoacoustic.limitations: Tunable approximation of critical bands, simultaneous and short forward masking; no standard compliance or listening-quality guarantee.

feedback.limitations: Bounded local proposals, not a global optimum; three channels cannot reproduce arbitrary PCM. Playback SPL and analogue circuit response are unknown.

envelope.limitations: One shared nonlinear DAC envelope: 16 AY or 32 YM level codes. Bounded proposals and coarse frequency grid; not an ideal triangle or independent channel envelopes.
